description: Tracked TEMPLATE (non-secret, account-neutral). Do not commit real account IDs, emails, subdomains, hostnames, or team origins here. Copy to .eliotr-state/cloudflare/operator-profile.json (ignored) and fill real values locally, or supply explicit env vars. See docs/implementation/cloudflare-runbook.md.

operator.auth_note: Browser OAuth via the local Wrangler profile is the ONLY permitted auth method. API tokens, service tokens, and key files are not used by this profile.

routing.route_note: workers.dev only. ELIOTR_CUSTOM_DOMAIN must be 0. Custom domains are out of scope for this profile.

operational_policy.overage_note: Free-tier operation with no paid overage: do not enable paid add-ons or usage-based billing. This policy does not claim a Cloudflare-provided hard cap; stay within free-tier limits by process and monitoring, not by relying on a platform cutoff.

secrets.note: This file MUST NOT contain secrets or token material: no API tokens, OAuth tokens, JWTs, private keys, passwords, service tokens, cookies, or session material. Generated IDs that belong in ignored receipts (.eliotr-state/, wrangler.deploy.jsonc, wrangler.local.jsonc) MUST NOT be committed here.
